data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 inherits SRC_003: the pruning-via-efficiency defense inherits the structural necessity of ownership-based localization for fact consolidation, since without ownership the invariants that make source-programme facts high-confidence would not carry forward. This inheritance is REFUTED IF a non-ownership allocation regime (e.g., open cross-lineage borrowing) is empirically observed to produce equally or more reliable consolidated facts, which would mean the inheritance is incidental rather than structural.
